messages.subject: For Ruud Joosten | Infrastructure, energy transition and government stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Royal BAM Group Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Ruud Joosten, Chief Executive Officer.

BAM's growth across infrastructure, residential development and energy-transition projects requires disciplined alignment across governments, clients, communities and sustainability commitments. That interface closely matches my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate complex stakeholder execution across regulated operations.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, sustainability and infrastructure stakeholder strategy might support Royal BAM Group's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Royal BAM Group.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
